description: Persistent subscription management for event-driven consumers like notification-hub

requirements.title: Subscription CRUD API
requirements.description: REST endpoints for subscription create, list, get, update, delete with filters.

requirements.title: Subscription field validation
requirements.description: Validates required fields and delivery_target for webhooks

requirements.title: Subscription filter combinations
requirements.description: List endpoint supports filter by owner, pattern, and enabled status

requirements.title: Subscription SQLite storage
requirements.description: Subscriptions persisted in SQLite with cascade delete for health records

requirements.title: Glob pattern matching on subscriptions
requirements.description: Subscriptions use segment-aware glob matching.

requirements.title: Webhook delivery
requirements.description: POST matching events to delivery_target URL with retry policy.

requirements.title: Webhook HTTP delivery
requirements.description: POST events with subscription ID and HMAC-SHA256 signature headers

requirements.title: Webhook retry with exponential backoff
requirements.description: Failed deliveries retried 3 times with exponential backoff

requirements.title: Delivery result logging
requirements.description: Failed deliveries logged with status, response_code, error

requirements.title: Subscription health tracking
requirements.description: Track delivery health with auto-disable on consecutive failures.

requirements.title: Subscription testing endpoint
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/test sends a synthetic test event.

requirements.title: Combined filter AND semantics
requirements.description: Multiple filters applied with AND semantics: all conditions must match

requirements.title: Cascade delete for health records
requirements.description: Deleting subscription cascades to remove associated health tracking records

requirements.title: Pattern matcher initialization
requirements.description: Compiles glob pattern from subscription filter at creation time

requirements.title: Pattern syntax validation
requirements.description: Validates glob pattern syntax on subscription create/update, rejects invalid patterns

requirements.title: Event match evaluation
requirements.description: Matches incoming event type against compiled subscription patterns

requirements.title: Exponential backoff interval calculation
requirements.description: Retry intervals: 1s, 2s, 4s with jitter for concurrent delivery

requirements.title: Structured delivery log format
requirements.description: Delivery log includes HTTP status, response body snippet, and latency

requirements.title: Delivery attempt tracking
requirements.description: Records each delivery attempt result (success/failure) with timestamp

requirements.title: Consecutive failure counter
requirements.description: Maintains running count of consecutive failures, resets on success

requirements.title: Auto-disable on failure threshold
requirements.description: Disables subscription after configurable consecutive failure count

requirements.title: Synthetic test event generation
requirements.description: Generates test event with subscription's pattern and synthetic payload

requirements.title: Test event delivery verification
requirements.description: Delivers test event to webhook and reports success/failure with response details

requirements.title: Test result reporting
requirements.description: Returns delivery attempt result with HTTP status, latency, and any error
